properties.displayName: UAV S80 - Cross-segment ISR Handoff Target Data Tampering
properties.description: Cross-segment(예: AF-to-Army) ISR 핸드오프 시 표적좌표(TargetCoordBefore/After)가 변경되고 변경자(HandoffOperator)가 Approved_Operators_List에 없는 비인가자인 경우를 탐지. 핸드오프 구간 표적정보 조작 위험. MITRE: T1565, T0832
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let coordTolerance = 0.01;
UAVC4I_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where isnotempty(TargetId)
| sort by TargetId asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend PrevTargetId = prev(TargetId), PrevLat = prev(Lat), PrevLon = prev(Lon), PrevClassification = prev(Classification), PrevConfidencePct = prev(ConfidencePct)
| where TargetId == PrevTargetId
| extend LatDiff = abs(Lat - PrevLat), LonDiff = abs(Lon - PrevLon)
| where LatDiff > coordTolerance or LonDiff > coordTolerance
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("ISR핸드오프_표적좌표변조_", TargetId, "_보고자:", ReportedBy, "_latDiff:", LatDiff, "_lonDiff:", LonDiff)
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, TargetId, Lat, Lon, PrevLat, PrevLon, Classification, ConfidencePct, Source, ReportedBy, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S80 - ISR Handoff Target Data Tampering - {{TargetId}}
